title: ConstantRef/v1
description: A reference to a physical or mathematical constant from a named source. The value and (optional) uncertainty are decimal strings (no exponent, no float coercion) so precision survives a round trip; the unit is a UCUM string or a QUDT IRI; the vintage names the edition (e.g. a CODATA year). Design decision (WP-B11): there is NO separate unit-ref schema; a unit is a single string field carried inline here and in SymbolTable/v1, because SRL does not yet carry a unit-algebra object (full dimensional analysis is deferred to WP-E40). Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

constant_id.description: Stable logical identifier for the constant within its source+vintage (e.g. 'codata2022.planck-constant'). Not a content hash; identity of a ConstantRef object is its envelope object_id.

source.description: The authority the constant is drawn from.

symbol.description: The conventional symbol for the constant (e.g. 'h', 'c', 'G').

value.description: The constant value as a decimal-string policy value: optional sign, integer digits, optional fractional digits, no exponent. Never a float; never NaN/Infinity.

uncertainty.description: The one-standard-deviation uncertainty as a decimal string, or null when the source does not report one. Never a float.

unit.description: The unit as a UCUM string (e.g. 'm.s-1', 'kg.m2.s-2') or a QUDT IRI (e.g. 'http://qudt.org/vocab/unit#MeterPerSecond'). Carried inline; SRL has no unit-ref object until WP-E40.

vintage.description: The edition/release the value was drawn from (e.g. 'CODATA-2022', 'QUDT-3.1.4', 'pack-2026-07'). A free-form but non-empty string.
